entities.summary: Martyn Ford is a British bodybuilder, social media personality, and actor. Ford gained significant attention and recognition for his physical stature and height, standing at around 6 feet 8 inches (203 cm) tall. He is often referred to as "The Nightmare" through the Boyka films.
